history.content: How do we integrate the web chat to help answer the questions that customers have?

To integrate the web chat into your website for answering customer questions, follow these steps:
1. Learn about the web chat integration by reviewing the provided overview. This will give you insights into the capabilities and benefits of using the web chat.
2. Deploy the web chat to your website or mobile app using the web chat integration settings in the Watson Assistant user interface.
3. Configure the web chat for your website and customers according to your preferences.
4. If you are a developer, you can further customize and extend the web chat by writing code and using the web chat API. Additionally, you can use a WebView with a JavaScript bridge to add the web chat to your mobile app.
For more detailed instructions, consult the documentation on Integrating the web chat with your website: <https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/assistant?topic=assistant-deploy-web-chat>.
Keep in mind that a web chat integration is automatically created for you when you create a new assistant or service instance.

This documentation is for the classic Watson Assistant experience. To see the documentation for the new Watson Assistant, please go [here](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/watson-assistant).



 Creating intents 

Intents are purposes or goals that are expressed in a customer's input, such as answering a question or processing a bill payment. By recognizing the intent expressed in a customer's input, the Watson Assistant service can choose the correct dialog flow for responding to it.

To learn more about creating intents, watch the following 2 1/2-minute video.



 Intent creation overview 



* Plan the intents for your application.

This documentation is for the classic Watson Assistant experience. To see the documentation for the new Watson Assistant, please go [here](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/watson-assistant).



 Adding a node with slots to a dialog 

In this tutorial, you will add slots to a dialog node to collect multiple pieces of information from a user within a single node. The node you create will collect the information that is needed to make a restaurant reservation.



 Learning objectives 

By the time you finish the tutorial, you will understand how to:



* Define the intents and entities that are needed by your dialog
* Add slots to a dialog node
* Test the node with slots





 Duration 

This tutorial will take approximately 30 minutes to complete.





 Prerequisite

About Watson Assistant 

Use IBM Watson® Assistant to build your own branded live chatbot into any device, application, or channel. Your chatbot, which is also known as an assistant, connects to the customer engagement resources you already use to deliver an engaging, unified problem-solving experience to your customers.
